messages:
maria: Heads-up — we're getting requests from product and console team for a single-pane view of continuous batching signals. They want batch-size distribution, per-model queue wait percentiles, and a saturation/ headroom indicator that can drive rollout decisions. Can infra/runtime own the instrumentation contract?

devin: +1. we need a stable naming scheme for metrics so dashboards don't explode whenever we change config. thinking: rts.batch.size.p50/p90/p99, rts.batch.wait.p50/p90/p99, rts.queue.depth, rts.saturation_ratio. open to other names.

jia: agree on p50/p90/p99. also want an eyeball-friendly CDF panel for batch sizes and a heatmap for queueing by region+model. will the runtime emit sample counts per bucket?

maria: runtime should emit histogram buckets for batch_size and wait_ms and a separate gauge for "saturation_ratio" = occupied_slots / total_slots. keep labels: model, region, pool, tier. no customer ids.

devin: implementation note: histograms will be in Prom format. suggest these metric names: rts_batch_size_bucket, rts_batch_size_count, rts_batch_size_sum; rts_wait_ms_bucket... and rts_saturation_ratio gauge. we can provide a prometheus recording rule to compute p50/p90.

paul: can we also emit an event when saturation_ratio > 0.9 for > 2m? product wants infra alerts to trigger fallback routing. maybe an alert label with pool and model.

lia (via metrics-bot): metrics-bot: added checklist item: expose histograms + saturation gauge + sample_rate metadata in /metrics-contract repo. See https://git.internal/metrics-contracts/continuous-batching for schema.

leah: UX ask from console: expose a lightweight composite "Batch Health" score (0-100) computed from p90 wait, p95 batch size, and saturation. want this in the rollouts page so PMs can decide canary length automatically. could be a recording rule that normalizes each signal. any objections?

devin: no objections. but we need to agree on normalization boundaries (e.g., p90 wait 0-200ms -> score mapping). runtime can't hardcode thresholds. propose default recording rules in infra repo and console can map them for display.

jia: telemetry ingestion note: don't send raw histograms for every request; sample at 1% for high-traffic models and 100% for low-traffic pools. annotate metric rts_sample_rate label.

maria: ops question — who wires alerts and on-call runbook? Suggest eng-sre own alerting, runtime provides metrics + recommended thresholds, product signs off on actions (fallback route, reduce batch target).

paul: i'll put together a draft runbook and alert set. will include playbook: investigate pool, rollback rollout, enable immediate fallback-route=always.

leah: console will add a read-only panel that pulls recording rules and shows the Batch Health trend and a per-model saturation timeline + quick action to toggle canary routing.

maria: timeline: propose metrics PR this week, recording rules + alerting PR next week, console panel in two weeks. can we commit to that?

devin: i can ship the prometheus metric exports and a stub PR for rules by EOD Fri.

jia: infra will add bucket definitions and sample rate config in the same PR.

paul: i'll draft runbook by Monday.

metrics-bot: metrics-bot: created issue INF-2312 "Continuous batching metrics: histograms, saturation gauge, sample rates" and linked to this thread.

maria: awesome — thanks all. if anyone wants to pair on the histogram boundaries ping me. Also, note: please avoid export of per-customer labels for privacy.

leah: noted. i'll coordinate with product on the Batch Health formula. :white_check_mark:
